attributes.name: Improvised Greatclub
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, bury this card to use your Strength or Survival skill + 2d8. If this is not your first combat check this turn, add 2d10 instead. After the check, succeed at a Strength or Survival 10 check to recharge this card instead of burying it. 

When you defeat a barrier that has the Lock, Obstacle, or Trap trait, reveal this card to draw a weapon or an item from your discard pile.
